newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares rise, Portucel jumps.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares rise, Portucel jumps.

text.p: 1735 GMT - Portuguese shares rose with activity dominated by pulp group Portucel Industrial. Shares in Portucel jumped seven percent to 1,129 escudos in volume of 583,165 shares on reports of progress in plans to restructure Portugal's pulp and paper sector.
* Shares of Portugal Telecom also surged, helped by the rise of other markets. PT closed at 6,314 escudos, up 67, in volume of 212,863 shares.
* Cement firm Cimpor was subject to a strong selling order and closed down 25 escudos to 3,655 in volume of 232,464 shares.
* Electrical engineering firm Efacec rose amid optimism over its 1996 results, closing at 1,400 escudos, up 90, in volume of 76,582 shares.
* Dealers expected positive sentiment to prevail in trade of "blue chips" tomorrow. "I think the market will stay high, but the trend will depend to an extent on other markets," said a dealer.
